title: Industrial Designer, CMF
note: CMF-focused internship at a home robotics startup; open to current Industrial Design students and recent grads.

facts.duties: Develop color, material and finish concepts; research materials and trends; make mood boards, palettes and renderings; help with sourcing and sample review.
facts.requirements: Current or recent Industrial Design degree; portfolio showing CMF sense; Adobe CC, KeyShot and CAD.
facts.apply: Apply online through the 'Apply for this role' link on Weave's careers page.
